message: background-image isn't supported in Outlook Windows; partly in Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android
hint: Background images can be used in VML. See [backgrounds.cm](https://backgrounds.cm/) and [VML documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/vml/web-workshop---how-to-use-vml-on-web-pages-----fill--element).

message: linear-gradient() isn't supported in Outlook Windows, Outlook.com, Yahoo! Mail Desktop Webmail, Yahoo! Mail iOS, Yahoo! Mail Android; partly in Gmail Android
hint: Gradients can be created in VML using `type="gradient"` on a `<v:fill>`. See [VML documentation](https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/vml/web-workshop---how-to-use-vml-on-web-pages-----fill--element#gradient-fill).

message: gradient text is invisible where gradients are dropped (Outlook, Yahoo)
hint: Give the text a solid color instead of color: transparent.
